*********************OVERVIEW*********

This .dll attaches to the running game process and enables the use of arbitrary-ID modded files, not listed in the game's manifest. It is the only feature that runs regardless of the config file and the primary purpose of its existence. Tested with player faces, player body models, player portraits, courts, arenas, team logos, jerseys and their companion font and tweak files. Other resource types are likely to work but not confirmed.

Other than that, it is deliberately made to function like looyh's Hooks developed for subsequent NBA 2K games. The following features can be turned on or off with the config file:

*** "rosterCustomData" - disables the game's roster sync logic, which is a REAL bitch in 2K17 and mercilessly preserves a lot of official roster values. Enabled by default and I sure recommend keeping it enabled if you want to edit any roster data related to jerseys, arenas, etc. and you wish for your changes to ever survive saving and loading the roster. 

*** "forcedisplayphotos" - makes the game always display a player's photo/action shot, even after he gets moved to a different team. Players who do not have photos will still be displayed as in-game renders. Enabled by default.

*** "quickGameReset" - forces the game to reset its default teams for Play Now and 2KU to the starting default teams. Enabled by default.

*** "unlockRetiredNumber" - allows you to assign retired numbers to players in the Edit Player menu. Enabled by default.

*** "unlockedShoesBrands" - disables the brand lock and allows you to assign any shoe to any player. Enabled by default.


Tested with Steam version of NBA 2K17 using an executable dated March 31st, 2017. Cannot vouch for this Hook working properly with other versions of the game. 


********************INSTALLATION********

Drop all contents of the "NBA 2K17 Hook" folder into your NBA 2K17 game directory, next to the game's executable file. Use alongside 2K17WAIGUADLL.dll and its accompanying dinput8.dll, which you can downloaded from the following link: https://forums.nba-live.com/downloads.php?view=detail&df_id=8772

Modded files are to be dropped in either "Modded" or "waigua" folder in the game directory.

********************UNINSTALLATION******

Delete all contents of the "NBA 2K17 Hook" folder from your NBA 2K17 game directory.
